description: Briefs for the 3D product hero: packaged goods of different shapes, one with a colour cue, and one without an approved call to action.

briefs.brief: Hero spot for Casa Verde, a cold-pressed olive oil from a single grove in Puglia, sold in a dark green glass bottle. Call to action: Order now. Warm, premium look.
Launch spot for Brisk Lime, a sparkling water in a 330 ml can with no sugar and no sweeteners. CTA: Find it in store. Bright and fresh.
Teaser for Orbit Mini, our new wireless earbuds that last eight hours per charge. Call to action: Pre-order. Dark tech look.
Product video for Morning Field, a loose-leaf green tea sold in a tin. The call to action is: Shop the tea. Soft and calm.
Make a slick 3D video for Lumo, our new face serum in a glass dropper bottle. Make it feel luxurious.
briefs.note: No call to action is given; the cta slot is verbatim, so the writer must report it missing rather than invent one.
